## Statute
§2(b)(2)(C)

## Reasoning
Section 2(b)(2)(C) states: "a taxpayer shall be considered as married at the close of his taxable year if his spouse (other than a spouse described in subparagraph (B)) died during the taxable year."

The facts state that Alice died on July 9th, 2014, and Bob was Alice's spouse (married Feb 3rd, 1992). Since Alice died during the 2014 taxable year, Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014, meaning Bob would be considered as married at the close of his 2014 taxable year.

The claim "Section 2(b)(2)(C) applies to Bob in 2014" is therefore true based on the statute and facts provided.

## Answer
Answer: Entailment
